audit_target: Section 2: Related Work & Adaptive Inference Taxonomy

taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.name: Dynamic Neural Networks & Multi-Branch Architectures
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.prior_work: Han et al. (2021), Huang et al. (MSDNet 2017)
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.core_idea: Conditionally execute sub-networks or spatial feature layers based on sample difficulty.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.what_it_achieves: Amortized FLOP reduction across dataset distributions.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.limitation: Shared feature backbones propagate early sensory corruptions to all deeper layers.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.edge_sla_limitation: Dynamic routing overhead introduces non-deterministic memory access patterns.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.why_it_does_not_solve_p23: Does not provide formal queueing delay bounds or independent perceptual risk metrics.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.exact_p23_differentiator: Decoupled dual-model cascade with orthogonal evidential risk gating and Pollaczek-Khinchine queueing bounds.

taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.name: Early-Exit Architectures
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.core_idea: Attach early classification heads to intermediate backbone layers.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.what_it_achieves: Fast exit for easy samples without executing deeper layers.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.limitation: Early exits suffer from negative overthinking and shared noise vulnerabilities.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.edge_sla_limitation: Intermediate exits cannot run asynchronously from the backbone pipeline.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.why_it_does_not_solve_p23: Vulnerable to common corruptions (Hendrycks & Dietterich 2019) that corrupt early layers.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.exact_p23_differentiator: Primary and secondary models have separate model weights and distinct computational graphs.

taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.name: Confidence- & Entropy-Gated Cascades
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.prior_work: Bolukbasi et al. (2017), Wang et al. (SkipNet 2018)
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.core_idea: Route to heavy model when maximum softmax probability is below a threshold or entropy is high.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.what_it_achieves: Empirical accuracy improvement on uncorrupted benchmarks.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.limitation: Softmax confidence is notoriously uncalibrated and overconfident on OOD noise (Guo 2017).
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.edge_sla_limitation: Heuristic thresholds lack formal duality guarantees and queue stability proofs.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.why_it_does_not_solve_p23: Fails under high-magnitude sensory noise where softmax remains falsely confident.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.exact_p23_differentiator: Gating is driven by calibrated Subjective Logic Dirichlet vacuity and Fourier blur bounds.

taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.name: Selective Prediction & Reject Option
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.core_idea: Allow the model to abstain from predicting when risk exceeds a target coverage constraint.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.what_it_achieves: Guaranteed low error on accepted prediction subset.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.limitation: Abstention drops the frame rather than invoking an alternative specialized model.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.edge_sla_limitation: Does not address hardware queue dynamics or real-time frame rate SLAs.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.why_it_does_not_solve_p23: Edge vision requires continuous situational awareness rather than passive dropping.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.exact_p23_differentiator: 4-tier active dispatch (ACCEPT, DEGRADE, DELEGATE, HALT) ensuring continuous safe operation.

taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.name: Speculative Execution & Model Cascades
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.prior_work: Viola & Jones (2001), Leviathan et al. (Speculative Decoding 2023)
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.core_idea: Execute fast draft model and verify with heavy model.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.limitation: Verification cost dominates if draft rejection rate is high.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.edge_sla_limitation: Draft-verify synchronization creates tail latency spikes.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.why_it_does_not_solve_p23: Lacks mathematical queueing analysis for streaming frame ingestion.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.exact_p23_differentiator: M/G/1 queueing delay bounds and Kingman heavy-traffic exponential tail guarantees.

taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.name: Resource-Aware Edge Inference & DVFS Schedulers
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.core_idea: Partition workloads across edge-cloud or scale frequency dynamically.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.what_it_achieves: Adapts execution to battery state and wireless bandwidth.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.limitation: Offloading incurs network jitter; DVFS has millisecond-scale transition hysteresis.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.edge_sla_limitation: Network round-trip times (>50ms) violate sub-5ms SLAs.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.why_it_does_not_solve_p23: P23 targets autonomous on-device edge execution without network dependency.
taxonomic_paradigms_evaluation.exact_p23_differentiator: Self-contained on-device Pareto-optimal routing with normalized Energy-Delay Product (EDP) optimization.
